documents.title: Settlement pack — Client settlement authority letter
documents.body:
SETTLEMENT AUTHORITY — Meridian Grain Cooperative

The Board authorises outside counsel to settle the Talvern matter for a total cash payment TO the Cooperative of not less than $1,900,000, and further authorises counsel to accept a structured settlement only if the present value is not less than that figure.

Counsel has NO authority to accept any offer below $1,900,000 without a further Board resolution. This authority expires 2026-12-31.

tasks.prompt: Settlement decision: read the client authority letter and the offer ledger in the matter folder in full. Determine whether counsel may accept the currently OPEN offer without returning to the client. Record the determination by calling litigation_cases_review_create with outcome exactly "accept_within_authority" if acceptable, or exactly "escalate_outside_authority" if it is not, and reviewer_role exactly "lead-counsel".
